GAMESYNDICATES
Programmator Edition

Easy to build, fun to master!

Perfect for beginners—place tiles in Worlds, change sky and environment, and tweak properties with Programmator.

Use step-by-step commands for more control.

Add your own textures and sounds to personalize your world.

Create your way!
